# Copilot Instructions — Forza Horizon 6 Telemetry

## Project overview
Desktop app that captures, records, and replays **Forza Horizon** UDP telemetry, with a live
dashboard and a 2D route map. Built with **Wails v2** (Go backend + Vue 3 frontend).

- Module: `forza-horizon-6-tuning` (Go 1.23, Wails v2.12.0)
- Window: 1024×768, title "forza-horizon-6-tuning" (see [main.go](../main.go))
- Target platform: primarily Windows (uses `explorer` to open folders).

## Architecture

### Go backend (root package `main`)
- [app.go](../app.go) — `App` struct bound to the frontend. Owns mode state machine
  (`live` | `recording` | `replaying`), context/cancel lifecycle, and the replay command channel.
  Exposes methods to JS: `StartRecord`, `StartReplay`, `StopSession`, `ReplayPause/Resume/Seek`,
  `ListSessions`, `RenameSession`, `OpenSessionsDir`, `GetSessionsDir`, `GetMode`,
  `GetListenAddr`, `SaveListenAddr`.
- [telemetry.go](../telemetry.go) — `ForzaHorizonPacket` struct (324-byte FH "Sled+Dash" layout),
  `packetSize = 324`, `parsePacket`, and `packetToSnapshot` (maps raw packet → `TelemetrySnapshot`
  JSON emitted to the frontend). Note: FH6 sends `gear=0` for neutral AND reverse; reverse is
  inferred from negative average wheel rotation (mapped to gear `11`).
- [record.go](../record.go) — `modeLive` and `modeRecord`: open a UDP socket on `getListenAddr()`,
  read 324-byte packets (200 ms read deadline for cancellation). Record prepends an `int64`
  nanosecond timestamp to each frame.
- [replay.go](../replay.go) — `modeReplay`: reads timestamped frames, supports realtime pacing,
  pause, and seek via `replayCmd` on a channel. `frameSize = 8 + packetSize`.
- [settings.go](../settings.go) — JSON settings persisted to
  `os.UserConfigDir()/ForzaHorizon6Telemetry/settings.json`. Holds `ListenAddr`
  (default `0.0.0.0:8000`). Thread-safe `getListenAddr()`; `loadSettings()` called in `startup`.

### Sessions storage
`.bin` recordings live in `os.UserCacheDir()/ForzaHorizon6Telemetry/sessions/`
(see `sessionsDir()` in [app.go](../app.go)). Each frame = `int64` timestamp + 324-byte packet.

### Mode lifecycle (important)
- On startup the app auto-starts the **live** listener.
- Record/replay cancel the current goroutine, run their mode, then call `resumeLive()` which
  retries the UDP bind (the previous goroutine may hold the port for up to one 200 ms read cycle).
- Events emitted to frontend: `telemetry` (snapshot per packet), `replay:progress`
  (`{frame, total}`), `session:mode` (mode string).

### Vue 3 frontend (`frontend/`)
- Vue 3 `<script setup>`, Vite. Entry [frontend/src/App.vue](../frontend/src/App.vue).
- **All CSS is global** in [frontend/src/style.css](../frontend/src/style.css) — App.vue has no
  `<style>` block. RouteMap.vue is the only component with scoped styles.
- [frontend/src/components/RouteMap.vue](../frontend/src/components/RouteMap.vue) — canvas 2D route
  map. Uses a `requestAnimationFrame` loop + dirty flag (decoupled from Vue reactivity for
  performance). Props: `points` (array of `{x,z}`), flat `curX`/`curZ` numbers. Exposes
  `markDirty()`. Draws auto-scaled bounding box, dim full trail + bright recent 200 pts + green
  current-position dot.
- [frontend/src/components/SessionCombobox.vue](../frontend/src/components/SessionCombobox.vue) —
  session picker (hides the `.bin` extension in display).
- Route points are accumulated in App.vue `addRoutePoint(x, z, isRaceOn)`: skips when not racing,
  skips < 2 m movement and > 100 m jumps (pause/teleport artifacts), capped at 10 000 points.

### Generated bindings
[frontend/wailsjs/go/main/App.js](../frontend/wailsjs/go/main/App.js) and `App.d.ts` are
**auto-generated by Wails** but were edited manually when adding methods so the frontend works
before a rebuild. After `wails dev`/`build`, Wails regenerates them — keep manual edits in sync
with the Go method signatures.

## Conventions
- Go method on `App` that can fail returns an **error string** (`""` = success), not a Go `error`,
  so it surfaces directly to JS.
- Tabs for Go (gofmt). Frontend uses 2-space indentation.
- Don't add a `<style>` block to App.vue — put styles in `style.css`.
- New user-facing backend method ⇒ add matching entries to `App.js` and `App.d.ts`.

## Build & run
- Dev (hot reload): `wails dev`
- Production build: `wails build`
- Go-only typecheck: `go build ./...`
- Frontend dev server also reachable at `http://localhost:34115` for calling Go from devtools.

## Telemetry source setup
In Forza, enable **Data Out** and point it at the host:port configured in Settings
(default UDP `0.0.0.0:8000`). Packet format expected is the 324-byte Forza Horizon layout.
